seasonal.issue_basis: Last day with complete ERA5-Land catchment forcing; flow history = observed Marala inflow
seasonal.model: Temporal Fusion Transformer · forecast mode · GloFAS-pretrained, fine-tuned on observed inflow · 3-seed ensemble
seasonal.interval: P10–P90, conformally calibrated (deployment offsets fitted on 2022–2026)

seasonal_means.model: Observed residual Ridge (90- and 180-day mean flow, correction to month-of-issue climatology)
seasonal_means.flow_history: Observed Marala inflow (Sindh rim-station after WAPDA ends in Dec 2024)

climate.chain: 8 NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 GCMs → bias correction to ERA5-Land → projection-mode TFT (calibrated P10/P50/P90) + storm-rainfall flood-peak model

peak_model.model: Censored log-normal regression on the largest Jun–Sep 3-day catchment rainfall

evidence.test_period: Issues from 2024-01-01 to 2026, leads 1–180 days (held out from training)

replay.test_period: Forecasts issued 31 Dec 2021 – 2024, never seen in training
replay.weather_caveat: These replays fed the models the weather that actually happened (reanalysis) in place of a weather forecast, so they show the best these models can do, not live accuracy.

ten_day_research.cohort: Observed target days 2022–2024, identical issue/target pairs for every model
ten_day_research.flood_day_definition: Observed flow above the 2016–2020 Q95 (2,495 m³/s)
ten_day_research.forcing_caveat: Future ERA5-Land reanalysis stood in for forecast weather, so these are upper-bound research scores, not operational accuracy
